name: newline-tools
short_description: Command-line utilities for processing large text files with operations like shuffle, dedupe, split, and sample.
long_description: Newline Tools is a Python library providing efficient, memory-conscious utilities for processing massive line-based text datasets. It offers four core operations: shuffle (randomize line order using buffered external sorting), dedupe (remove duplicate lines using Bloom filters), split (partition files by count, size, or proportion), and sample (extract random subsets via reservoir or index sampling). Designed for datasets that exceed available RAM, these tools use streaming algorithms and temporary file management to handle gigabyte-scale files on commodity hardware. Useful for data preparation, preprocessing machine learning datasets, and general text file manipulation.

modules.description: Implements in-place shuffling of large files using buffered external sorting with multiple temporary files and weighted random selection.
Removes duplicate lines from files using Bloom filter probabilistic data structure for memory-efficient deduplication.
Splits large files into multiple parts by count, size, or custom proportions with sequential line distribution.
Samples random subsets of lines from files using reservoir sampling or index-based sampling algorithms.
Utility function for efficiently counting total lines in a file for progress tracking and size calculations.
Command-line interface entry point with argument parsing for all four operations and integration with the public API.
Package initialization exposing public API classes and metadata including version, author, and license information.
